brief: A daily photo-journey & habit-tracking mobile app for individuals, couples, and friend squads. It should feel tactile, warm, intentional, and enduring — like a pocket camera and a shared travel journal, far from cold corporate trackers or noisy social feeds.
criteria: Success: reads effortlessly at 16 px, works in one colour and dark mode, captures 'Our + Journey' and daily photography without clip-art camera clichés.

concepts.name: Milestone Loop
concepts.idea: An open circular journey trail ('O') leading up to a bold tactile shutter milestone dot at 45°.
rationale: Unites the initial 'O', a continuous daily path, and a tactile camera shutter button in just 8 anchor points
Generous negative-space channels and a dedicated 16 px small-size cut keep the mark razor-sharp down to browser favicons
Warm Editorial Ink (#1E1B18) and Ourney Terracotta (#CC4A2F) establish an ownable, non-blue visual signature with 4.62:1+ contrast
Pairs seamlessly with a custom-constructed geometric 'ourney' wordmark (zero stock font dependencies)

recommendation: Milestone Loop is approved as Ourney's primary brand mark, delivering a timeless symbol that scales from a 16 px status icon to app tiles, shareable journey posters, and physical merch.
next_steps: Deploy app-icon and web-icon assets into apps/mobile
Use horizontal and stacked SVG lockups across onboarding, splash, and share cards
Follow BRAND_GUIDELINES.md for clear space, minimum sizes, and dark/light persona themes
